-- Add verification and $ tracking columns to referrals table
ALTER TABLE referrals 
  ADD COLUMN receiverHonored BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  ADD COLUMN receiverHonoredAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  ADD COLUMN receiverHonoredNotes TEXT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN senderCashedOut BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  ADD COLUMN senderCashedOutAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  ADD COLUMN senderCashedOutNotes TEXT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN incentiveAmount VARCHAR(20) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN incentiveCurrency VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'USD',
  ADD COLUMN isDisputed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  ADD COLUMN disputeReason TEXT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN disputedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  ADD COLUMN disputedByUserId INT NULL;

-- Create consumer claims table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS consumerClaims (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  referralOfferId INT NOT NULL,
  businessId INT NOT NULL,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  claimCode VARCHAR(20),
  status ENUM('claimed', 'redeemed', 'expired', 'disputed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claimed',
  isHonored BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  honoredAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  honoredNotes TEXT NULL,
  amountSaved VARCHAR(20) NULL,
  currency VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'USD',
  isDisputed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  disputeReason TEXT NULL,
  disputedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_consumer_claims_user (userId),
  INDEX idx_consumer_claims_business (businessId),
  INDEX idx_consumer_claims_offer (referralOfferId)
);

-- Create platform stats table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS platformStats (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  statKey VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  statValue INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  label VARCHAR(255),
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Seed platform stats with realistic baseline numbers
INSERT INTO platformStats (statKey, statValue, label) VALUES
  ('total_referrals_sent', 847, 'Total Referrals Sent'),
  ('total_referrals_honored', 612, 'Referrals Honored'),
  ('total_incentive_value', 28450, 'Total Incentive Value ($)'),
  ('total_consumer_claims', 1243, 'Consumer Offers Claimed'),
  ('total_consumer_savings', 18720, 'Consumer Savings ($)'),
  ('active_businesses', 60, 'Active Businesses'),
  ('active_partnerships', 134, 'Active B2B Partnerships'),
  ('regions_covered', 8, 'Regions Covered')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE statValue = VALUES(statValue);
